title: Grateful Dead Live at Olympic Center on 1983-10-17
lineage: Sony PCM-R500, AES digital output > Benchmark DAC1, XLR analog output > Grace Lunatec V3, sample rate at 48 KHz, AES digiout) > AES digital input, professional mode/sync - LynxTwo soundcard in E6400 dual core processor-based PC > HD as 24 bit/48 KHz WAV > Ozone 3.0 > MBIT+ and > CDWAV 1.9 Converted to 16/44.1 KHz WAV with r8brain > FLAC (level 8). with TLH Recording, editing and mastering with Wavelab 5.0. All cables were Mogami Gold 0.3m pro-audio XLR cables
source: DAT Copy of Master Cassette Sennheiser MD 441 U > Sony TCD-5M FOB 10th Row Recorded and Copied to DAT by Chuck Jackson

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a thrilling show featuring an epic Sugaree opener and stellar second‑set gems like Birdsong and Going Down the Road Feels Bad.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crisp, clean, board‑like clarity that puts listeners right in the venue. The performance itself is highlighted as one of the best at this house, with a 16‑minute Sugaree opener, fiery Rooster, and a second set packed with Birdsong, Sampson, To Lay Me Down, and a ripping Going Down the Road Feels Bad.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are strongly positive (average 4.6 stars), emphasizing both superb soundboard quality and an outstanding musical performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers describe the audio as crisp, clean, sweet, and board‑like, noting that it captures the show exactly as it sounded live.

standout_songs: Going Down the Road Feels Bad
show_quality.setlist_flow: The opener is described as an intense, 16‑minute Sugaree that sets a high energy level, which carries through the first set and blossoms into a second set filled with powerful jams and sweet drum/space sections.

band_member_comments.Drums: Positive remarks about the drums and space sections, noting their sweetness and energy.
